name: stead
description: Your agent goes in your stead — personal AI agents that meet with each other on your behalf.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/agent && npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/server && npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/desktop
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/agent && npm run build --workspace @ai-coworker/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/agent packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace @ai-coworker/desktop
